title: Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.
   D. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.
   B. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Modes of preservation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ulul-Azm Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulul-Azm Prophets.
   B. Say Ulul-Azm Prophets has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulul-Azm Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T.
   D. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Belief in revealed scriptures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Ulul-Azm Prophets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. B — Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. B — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. A — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Belief in revealed scriptures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ulul-Azm Prophets; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
